(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((count (length (find-color g 8)))
                  (per-quad (quotient count 4))
                  (tile (cond
                          ((= per-quad 4) (list (list 8 8) (list 8 8)))
                          ((= per-quad 3) (list (list 0 8) (list 8 8)))
                          ((= per-quad 2) (list (list 0 0) (list 8 8)))
                          ((= per-quad 1) (list (list 0 0) (list 0 8)))
                          (else (list (list 0 0) (list 0 0))))))
             (build-grid 5
                         5
                         (r c)
                         (cond
                           ((= r 2) 0)
                           ((= c 2) 0)
                           (else (let ((tr (remainder (if (> r 2) (- r 3) r) 2))
                                       (tc (remainder (if (> c 2) (- c 3) c) 2)))
                                   (list-ref (list-ref tile tr) tc)))))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((count
                    (let ((cyan-objs (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 8))
                                             (objects g 0))))
                      (if (null? cyan-objs) 0

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((count (length (find-color g 8)))
                (per-quad (quotient count 4))
                (markers
                 (sort
                  (filter (lambda (p)
                            (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                              (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 8)))))
                          (grid-positions g))
                  (lambda (a b)
                    (or (< (first a) (first b))
                        (and (= (first a) (first b))
                             (< (second a) (second b)))))))
                (selected (list-ref markers (- per-quad 1)))
                (selected-color (at g (first selected) (second selected)))
                (tile (cond
                        ((= per-quad 4) (list (list 8 8) (list 8 8)))
                        ((= per-quad 3) (list (list 0 8) (list 8 8)))
                        ((= per-quad 2) (list (list 0 0) (list 8 8)))
                        ((= per-quad 1) (list (list 0 0) (list 0 8)))
                        (else (list (list 0 0) (list 0 0)))))
                (base
                 (build-grid 5
                             5
                             (r c)
                             (cond
                               ((= r 2) 0)
                               ((= c 2) 0)
                               (else
                                (let ((tr (remainder (if (> r 2) (- r 3) r) 2))
                                      (tc (remainder (if (> c 2) (- c 3) c) 2)))
                                  (list-ref (list-ref tile tr) tc)))))))
           (set-cell base 2 2 selected-color))))
